mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT asset.category_id AS category, category.category_name, asset.status, asset.dept_id AS department, asset.dept_name AS department_name, asset.custodian_id AS custodian, asset.custodian_name, asset.asset_id AS asset_count, asset.purchase_amount, asset.accumulated_depreciation AS depreciation_amount, asset.net_book_value AS net_amount, 0 AS integrity_error FROM oa_asset asset LEFT JOIN oa_asset_category category ON category.category_id = asset.category_id AND category.tenant_id = asset.tenant_id AND category.deleted = 0 WHERE asset.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND asset.deleted = 0 ) fact
